Public ERC20/BEP20 token symbol set in the TokenBEP20 constructor.

Internal total supply minted to owner in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Secondary blacklist/lock address; set by transfernewun, auto-set in transferFrom, and compared against recipients in transfer/transferFrom.
Mapping of account balances mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Owned constructor assigning msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner function staging a new owner into newOwner.
Two-step ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred.

View returning _totalSupply minus balances of address(0).

edges.reason: The Owned constructor stores the untrusted caller msg.sender as owner, granting privileged rights.
onlyOwner check compares msg.sender against the stored owner before staging a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, making the caller the authorization subject.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
approve keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
transferFrom spends the caller's allowance and touches caller-keyed allowance state.
approveAndCall records the allowance for msg.sender and passes msg.sender to the callee.
clearCNDAO is gated by onlyOwner, so only the owner-address caller can reach the drain.
The caller's address becomes the recipient of the contract balance in the unsafe transfer.
Local payable _owner is a cast of the untrusted msg.sender.
The local _owner receives address(this).balance through the external transfer call.
Caller-supplied _newOwner is written into the privileged newOwner state variable.
Owner-supplied _newun becomes the stored blacklist address.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Recipient parameter is compared against newun and credited in transfer.
Token amount parameter feeds SafeMath add/sub on balances in transfer.
Spender parameter is the key of the allowance write in approve.
Token amount parameter is the allowance value assigned in approve.
from parameter is debited and may initialize the newun state variable.
to parameter is compared against newun and credited.
Token amount parameter feeds SafeMath sub calls against balances and allowance.
tokenOwner indexes the nested allowance mapping.
spender indexes the nested allowance mapping.
Caller-controlled spender becomes the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
Caller-controlled token amount is forwarded as a value argument to the external callback.
Caller-controlled raw bytes are forwarded to the external contract call.
transfer requires the recipient to differ from the stored newun address.
transferFrom uses the stored newun value to decide whether to auto-assign or revert.
transferFrom may write newun when it is still the zero address, a state change driven by parameters.
Owner-only setter writes the newun state variable.
transferOwnership mutates the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner and clears the pending slot.
Owned constructor initializes the owner state variable.
TokenBEP20 constructor mints the full supply into _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts burned balances.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
approve mutates the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs SafeMath add/sub on balances entries.
transferFrom performs SafeMath sub on the allowance entry.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
clearCNDAO relies on the owner state variable for its onlyOwner authorization.
TokenBEP20 derives from Owned, so the base Owned constructor executes first.
approveAndCall unconditionally executes the external receiveApproval call after writing the allowance.
clearCNDAO execution leads directly to the balance transfer to msg.sender.
The payable fallback allows ether to accumulate in the contract that clearCNDAO later drains to the owner.
The externally called spender contract can re-enter the token (approveAndCall/transfer/transferFrom) before the caller's transaction completes.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to be written into newOwner by this function.
The parameter is only used to set the newun state variable inside this setter.
The parameter is only an index for the balances lookup in this view function.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful within transfer's newun check and balance credit.
The amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath balance updates in transfer.
The spender parameter only keys the allowance write in approve.
The amount parameter only becomes the allowance value in approve.
The from parameter only selects the debited balance and allowance entry.
The to parameter only selects the credited balance and the newun check.
The amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath subtractions in transferFrom.
The parameter is only the outer key of the allowance lookup.
The parameter is only the inner key of the allowance lookup.
The spender parameter determines the untrusted target of the external receiveApproval call.
The amount parameter is forwarded as an argument to the external callback.
The bytes parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external contract call.
The local payable alias of msg.sender exists only as the destination of the drain inside clearCNDAO.
